property_summary: For every caller and value, only the contract deployer (owner) can successfully call withdraw and cause the contract balance to decrease by that value; the mutant inverts the check and therefore allows a non-owner caller to withdraw (or prevents the owner), so there exists some caller/value where behavior differs.
change_summary: Invert the onlyOwner check to require caller is NOT owner, changing authorization and allowing owner-protected withdrawals to behave differently.
